notes: The list already covers essentially all of Schumann's original violin works and his authorised alternative-instrument versions (Opp. 70, 73, 94, 102, 113, 129). The main established gaps are the widely taught Suzuki arrangements; arrangements of Op. 94 No. 2 (e.g. Kreisler) and the F-A-E Intermezzo (part of WoO 27) were skipped as duplicates.
